items.title: Active Gaming
items.desc: We hit up escape rooms, VR arenas, and challenge venues like Activate, CUBE Challenges, and VR Vibe. Good for anyone who'd rather move, solve, and compete than sit still.

items.title: Adrenaline
items.desc: Waterparks, karting, paintballing, skiing, — if it gets your heart racing, we're probably already planning it.

items.title: Theatre
items.desc: We catch plays, musicals, and live shows around the city, plus run our own improv nights. Basically any excuse to be dramatic.

items.title: Cuisine
items.desc: Group dinners, halal restaurant crawls, and the occasional cooking night — for anyone who plans their week around food.

items.title: Arts & Crafts
items.desc: Painting nights, DIY sessions, and low-key crafternoons — no talent required, just vibes and glitter.

items.title: Field
items.desc: Weekend getaways, cabin trips, and the occasional wellness retreat — for when the group chat needs to actually leave the city.

items.title: Badminton
items.desc: The badminton crew, gathered in one place — same weekly sessions as the Sports tab, just easier to find and join here too.

items.title: ADHD / Neurodivergence
items.desc: A low-pressure space for neurodivergent sisters to connect, vent, swap strategies, and just exist without masking.

items.title: Built by Her
items.desc: A coffee circle for Muslimah entrepreneurs and creatives to connect, reflect, and grow together.
